.: type Match struct {

	Services []string `json:"services,omitempty"`

	Protocols []string `json:"protocols,omitempty"`

	MaxVersion string `json:"max_version,omitempty"`

	MinVersionExclusive bool `json:"min_version_exclusive,omitempty"`

	MaxVersionExclusive bool `json:"max_version_exclusive,omitempty"`

	BannerRegex string `json:"banner_regex,omitempty"`

	AllOf []Match `json:"all_of,omitempty"`
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

.: type Output struct {

.: type Result struct {
	PlannerMiss bool `json:"planner_miss,omitempty"`

	Verdict Verdict `json:"verdict"`

	Output Output `json:"output"`

	Error string `json:"error,omitempty"`

	ElapsedMS int64 `json:"elapsed_ms"`
}

job: func Run(ctx context.Context, engine *scribe.Engine, request Request, resolve Resolver) (Result, error)

job: type Request struct {
	SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`

	ID string `json:"id"`

	ScriptID string `json:"script_id"`

	Source string `json:"source,omitempty"`

	Dialect scribe.Dialect `json:"dialect"`

	Args map[string]any `json:"args,omitempty"`

	Target scribe.Target `json:"target"`

	Limits scribe.Limits `json:"limits"`

	Capabilities []string `json:"capabilities"`
}

job: type Resolver func(context.Context, string, scribe.Dialect) ([]byte, error)

job: type Result struct {
	SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`

	ID string `json:"id"`

	Report report.Envelope `json:"report"`
}
